comments.body:
Looks like one of the below flags should help to resolve your issue:

- `--config=ci_linux_aarch64_cuda13` - if you build cuda13
- `--config=ci_linux_aarch64_cuda12` or `--config=ci_linux_aarch64_cuda` - if you build cuda12

You could add it before the last BUILD_FLAGS
Example for cuda13:
`
BUILD_FLAGS+='--output_path=$PIP_WHEEL_DIR '
BUILD_FLAGS+='--bazel_options=--config=ci_linux_aarch64_cuda13  '
BUILD_FLAGS+='--clang_path=/usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang'
`

At least it resolves exactly the same issue when I test your code on my virtual machine.
